summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private. Evidence: official API documentation establishes access mechanics only; current public terms do not establish rights to store, transform, cache, publicly display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, or monetize returned data. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is configured for 39 sites but has documented source-permission errors. Data quality is yellow for analytics and revenue attribution. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission; ROI, margin, and causal lift remain unsupported. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when existing consent, cookie and analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, claims substantiation, provenance and rights, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards are preserved. No new telemetry, monetization expansion, rights-dependent content, unsupported claims, external outreach, or public exposure is approved. Human counsel is required before relying on upstream permission or expanding monetization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence exists for official API documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms; no task is closable. Open tasks remain source rights, alert-data retention and workflows, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields, provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = counsel_required and launch-blocked; missing written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator and vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Compliance, data-quality, site, analytics, revenue, launch evidence, and launch-readiness review supports containment-only execution. Incomplete telemetry is not a general growth blocker. Private or gated sites require an explicit keep-private decision and completed launch checklist before exposure. No go-live proposal is supported.
